name: Up Your Arsenal (RAC3)
source: racman-official RaCTrainer/Games/RAC3/ActiveMobysForm.cs reads oClass at 0xAA and UID at 0xB2; RaCTrainer/MemoryForm.cs uses the rac2.Moby struct for every game that is not RAC1 or RAC4, so the RAC2 layout applies

position.from: rac2.Moby Vec4 position (x, y, z of the Vec4 at 0x10)

oClass.from: rac2.Moby ushort oClass, confirmed by ActiveMobysForm's 0xAA

uid.from: rac2.Moby short UID, confirmed by ActiveMobysForm's 0xB2
